description:
Sends a sample alert mail (two made-up events, "Sample" in the subject) at once and outside the queue to every current alert recipient, each in their own language. At most 5 requests a minute per address, counted together with the test mail, and one sample at a time (a second request while one runs answers 429). A recipient the server refuses does not stop the others; a failure of the server (connection, login, TLS, timeout) stops the run. When something fails the answer is a 400 with the (scrubbed) reply for the first failure and its address in message_values.address, and the counts message_values.failed, message_values.sent and message_values.skipped (the recipients not tried). Answers 400 with error.notify-no-recipients when nobody gets alert mails.

Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch)

200.description: The sample was handed to the server for every recipient

sent.description: The number of recipients the sample went to
